title: The Way To Geometry
author: Petrus Ramus

authorInfo.bio: Petrus Ramus (1515–1572) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Way to Geometry" by Petrus Ramus is a scientific publication written in the late 16th century. This book serves as a practical guide for various professions, including astronomers, engineers, geographers, architects, land-measurers, carpenters, seamen, painters, and carvers, focusing on essential geometric principles and applications.
